words.enDefinition: a short US document setting out key information about a fund

examples.en: In our class pack, the summary prospectus stated the fund's objective and listed its main risks.
examples.zh: 在课程材料中，「简式招募说明书」写明了基金目标并列出了主要风险。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to find the cost table in the sample fund's summary prospectus.
examples.zh: 导师让我们在样本基金的「简式招募说明书」里找到费用表。

words.enDefinition: the full-length US prospectus containing a fund's detailed disclosures

examples.en: The statutory prospectus explained the fund's dealing arrangements in more detail than the shorter document.
examples.zh: 「法定完整招募说明书」比简式文件更详细地解释了基金申赎安排。

examples.en: Our tutor used the statutory prospectus to show where the financial highlights appeared in the filing.
examples.zh: 导师用「法定完整招募说明书」指出了申报文件中的财务摘要位置。

words.enDefinition: a supplementary US filing with further details about a fund

examples.en: We used the statement of additional information to read about the sample fund's board members.
examples.zh: 我们通过「补充信息说明书」了解样本基金的董事会成员。

examples.en: The sample prospectus pointed to the statement of additional information for details about proxy voting.
examples.zh: 样本招募说明书指向「补充信息说明书」，说明可在那里查到代理投票的细节。

collocations: read the statement of additional information
details in the statement of additional information
update a statement of additional information

words.enDefinition: a later notice that adds to or updates a prospectus

examples.en: The prospectus supplement showed that the sample fund had appointed a new portfolio manager.
examples.zh: 「招募说明书补充文件」显示样本基金任命了新的组合经理。

examples.en: Our group compared the fee table with the prospectus supplement dated two weeks later.
examples.zh: 我们小组把费用表和晚两周发布的「招募说明书补充文件」做了比较。

words.enDefinition: a short document summarising a fund's main features and current figures

examples.en: The fund fact sheet showed the ten largest holdings and the date the figures were recorded.
examples.zh: 「基金概况表」列出了十项最大持仓以及数据记录日期。

examples.en: Our tutor gave each group a fund fact sheet to compare with the longer annual report.
examples.zh: 导师给每组发了一份「基金概况表」，让大家和更长的年报作比较。

words.enDefinition: a report to fund investors covering a full financial year

examples.en: The annual shareholder report compared the sample fund's performance with its index over the full year.
examples.zh: 「年度持有人报告」将样本基金与指数的全年表现作了对比。

examples.en: We found the year's actual fund expenses in the annual shareholder report used in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂用的「年度持有人报告」中找到了该年基金的实际费用。

collocations: expenses in the annual shareholder report

words.enDefinition: a report to fund investors covering half a financial year

examples.en: The semiannual shareholder report covered six months of expenses for the sample US fund.
examples.zh: 「半年度持有人报告」涵盖了这只美国样本基金六个月的费用。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which dates were covered by the semiannual shareholder report in the exercise.
examples.zh: 导师让我们找出练习中的「半年度持有人报告」涵盖了哪些日期。

collocations: figures from the semiannual shareholder report

words.enDefinition: what the fund aims to achieve through its investments

examples.en: The investment objective described the sample fund's aim of matching a broad regional index.
examples.zh: 「投资目标」写明，样本基金力求跟踪一项广泛覆盖该地区的指数。

examples.en: We compared the investment objective in two documents from different dates for the same fund.
examples.zh: 我们比较了同一基金不同时期的两份文件里列出的「投资目标」。

words.enDefinition: the main approaches a fund uses to pursue its objective

examples.en: The principal investment strategies section explained why the fund held only some index constituents.
examples.zh: 「主要投资策略」一节解释了基金为何只持有部分指数成分证券。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the principal investment strategies explained the sample fund's preference for smaller companies.
examples.zh: 导师问，「主要投资策略」有没有说明样本基金为何更偏向较小规模的公司。

collocations: a change in principal investment strategies

words.enDefinition: the main investment risks disclosed for a fund

examples.en: The principal risks section discussed what could happen if the fund's foreign holdings lost value.
examples.zh: 「主要投资风险」一节讨论了基金境外持仓贬值时可能发生什么。

examples.en: Students highlighted principal risks in the sample document before discussing the fund's short operating history.
examples.zh: 同学们在样本文件中标出了「主要投资风险」，然后讨论该基金较短的运作历史。

words.enDefinition: a table listing fees and expenses associated with owning fund shares

examples.en: The fee table separated charges paid by shareholders from expenses taken from the fund's assets.
examples.zh: 「费用表」把持有人直接支付的费用和从基金资产中扣除的费用分开列示。

examples.en: We used the fee table to compare the listed costs of two sample share classes.
examples.zh: 我们用「费用表」比较了两个样本份额类别列出的费用。

collocations: charges shown in the fee table

words.enDefinition: an illustration of costs using specified fictional investment assumptions

examples.en: We read the hypothetical expense example before comparing the amounts shown for one and five years.
examples.zh: 我们先看了「假设费用示例」，再比较其列出的一年和五年的金额。

examples.en: The hypothetical expense example assumed a starting investment and a constant return for the classroom calculation.
examples.zh: 为了便于课堂计算，「假设费用示例」设定了初始投资额和固定回报率。

collocations: a hypothetical expense example in the prospectus
assumptions behind a hypothetical expense example

words.enDefinition: a detailed list of investments held on a stated date

examples.en: The schedule of investments listed each security held by the sample fund at year end.
examples.zh: 「投资明细表」列出了样本基金年末持有的每项证券。

examples.en: We checked the schedule of investments after finding a shortened holdings list in the classroom summary.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂摘要里看到简略持仓清单后，又查了「投资明细表」。

collocations: positions listed in the schedule of investments

words.enDefinition: a release of information about the investments a fund holds

examples.en: The exercise asked which asset categories appeared in the fund's most recent portfolio holdings disclosure.
examples.zh: 练习问，基金最近一次「组合持仓披露」中列出了哪些类资产。

examples.en: The dates on the portfolio holdings disclosure helped us distinguish it from the earlier fact sheet.
examples.zh: 我们看了「组合持仓披露」上的日期，把它和此前的基金概况表区分开来。

words.enDefinition: a manager's explanation of portfolio activity and performance

examples.en: The portfolio manager commentary linked the quarter's results to weakness in two large holdings.
examples.zh: 「组合经理评述」把本季度业绩与两项大额持仓表现疲软联系起来。

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to distinguish the portfolio manager commentary from the table of reported returns.
examples.zh: 导师让我们区分「组合经理评述」和所报告的回报率表。

words.enDefinition: a short disclosure about a packaged investment's risks, performance, and costs

examples.en: The European sample key information document highlighted the product's risks and charges on separate pages.
examples.zh: 欧洲样本「关键信息文件」在不同页面分别列出了产品风险和费用。

examples.en: Our tutor compared a key information document for an EU fund with its longer prospectus.
examples.zh: 导师把一只欧盟基金的「关键信息文件」和更长的招募说明书作了比较。

collocations: costs in a key information document

words.enDefinition: a short investor disclosure used under certain UCITS rules

examples.en: An archived UK key investor information document showed the sample fund's objective and ongoing charges.
examples.zh: 一份存档的英国「投资者关键信息文件」列出了样本基金的投资目标和持续费用。

examples.en: The class identified the risk scale in an archived key investor information document from the UK.
examples.zh: 同学们在一份存档的英国「投资者关键信息文件」中找到了风险等级划分。

collocations: review a key investor information document
an archived key investor information document
charges in the key investor information document

words.enDefinition: a short disclosure under the UK's consumer composite investments regime

examples.en: The UK example's product summary explained the fund's costs and described its intended holding period.
examples.zh: 英国样例的「投资产品摘要」解释了基金费用，并说明了预期持有期。

examples.en: Our tutor compared the risk wording in a UK product summary with the fund's prospectus.
examples.zh: 导师比较了英国「投资产品摘要」和基金招募说明书的风险措辞。

collocations: costs disclosed in a product summary

words.enDefinition: a group of shares in a fund with specific terms

examples.en: Each share class in the example held the same investments but charged different ongoing fees.
examples.zh: 示例中的每个「基金份额类别」都持有相同的底层投资，但持续费用不同。

examples.en: We checked which share class the performance table referred to before copying its figures.
examples.zh: 记录数据前，我们先核对业绩表说的是哪个「基金份额类别」。

words.enDefinition: fund units that keep income invested within the fund

examples.en: The UK sample's accumulation units retained investment income within the fund instead of paying it out.
examples.zh: 这个英国样本的「累积型基金份额」把投资收益留在基金内，不对外支付。

examples.en: The tutor asked why the distribution column was empty for the accumulation units in the exercise.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么练习中「累积型基金份额」的分配栏是空的。

words.enDefinition: fund units that pay out income allocated to investors

examples.en: Holders of the sample's income units received distributions twice a year under the stated policy.
examples.zh: 按样本所列政策，「分配型基金份额」的持有人每年收到两次收益分配。

examples.en: We found the payment dates for income units in a separate table on the provider's factsheet.
examples.zh: 我们在基金机构概况表的另一个表格中找到了「分配型基金份额」的付款日期。

words.enDefinition: a share class that seeks to reduce certain exchange-rate effects

examples.en: The currency-hedged share class in our case sought to reduce fluctuations against its stated dealing currency.
examples.zh: 案例中的「货币对冲份额类别」力求减少相对于所列交易货币的汇率波动影响。

examples.en: The tutor asked why returns for a currency-hedged share class could differ from another class's returns.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么「货币对冲份额类别」和另一个份额类别的回报可能不同。

collocations: compare a currency-hedged share class with other classes
returns for a currency-hedged share class

words.enDefinition: a class of fund shares intended for individual investors

examples.en: The sample prospectus showed a lower entry amount for its retail share class than for institutions.
examples.zh: 样本招募说明书中，「零售份额类别」的起投金额低于机构类别。

examples.en: Our group noted that the retail share class had a separate line in the fee table.
examples.zh: 我们小组注意到，「零售份额类别」在费用表中单独占一行。

collocations: terms for a retail share class
fees on a retail share class

words.enDefinition: a class of fund shares intended primarily for institutions

examples.en: The institutional share class in our exercise listed a different expense ratio from the retail class.
examples.zh: 练习中的「机构份额类别」列出的费用率与零售类别不同。

examples.en: We checked the minimum for the institutional share class before comparing costs in the sample prospectus.
examples.zh: 我们先核实了「机构份额类别」的最低投资额，再比较样本招募说明书里的费用。

collocations: an institutional share class of a fund
an expense ratio for an institutional share class

words.enDefinition: moving a holding from one class to another within the same fund

examples.en: The prospectus supplement explained when a share class conversion would take place in the classroom case.
examples.zh: 课堂案例的招募说明书补充文件解释了何时会进行「份额类别转换」。

examples.en: We asked how the share class conversion changed the names shown on the sample statement.
examples.zh: 我们问，「份额类别转换」后样本对账单上显示的名称会怎样改变。

collocations: terms for a share class conversion

words.enDefinition: the date a specific class of a fund began operating

examples.en: We checked the share class inception date after seeing that the chart began much later.
examples.zh: 看到图表起始时间晚得多后，我们核对了「份额类别设立日期」。

examples.en: The share class inception date showed why that class lacked a ten-year record in the table.
examples.zh: 「份额类别设立日期」解释了为什么该类别在表中没有十年业绩记录。

collocations: check the share class inception date
report a share class inception date
return since the share class inception date

words.enDefinition: the date a fund started operating

examples.en: The factsheet gave the fund inception date beside the oldest figures in the performance section.
examples.zh: 概况表在业绩部分最早的数据旁列出了「基金设立日期」。

examples.en: We checked the fund inception date to see whether the five-year comparison was available yet.
examples.zh: 我们核对了「基金设立日期」，看目前有没有五年期比较数据。

collocations: performance since the fund inception date

words.enDefinition: the smallest amount accepted for a first investment in a fund

examples.en: The minimum initial investment differed across the classes listed in the exercise's sample prospectus.
examples.zh: 练习提供的样本招募说明书中，各个份额类别的「首次投资最低金额」不同。

examples.en: Our lecturer asked which line of the table stated the minimum initial investment for new holders.
examples.zh: 讲师问，表格中哪一行写的是新持有人的「首次投资最低金额」。

words.enDefinition: the smallest amount accepted for a later purchase

examples.en: The fund's minimum subsequent investment was listed below the amount needed to open a holding.
examples.zh: 基金的「追加投资最低金额」列在首次申购所需金额的下方。

examples.en: We compared the minimum subsequent investment in the two classes shown on the application form.
examples.zh: 我们比较了申请表上两个类别的「追加投资最低金额」。

words.enDefinition: the currency used for the fund's main accounting and valuations

examples.en: The fund base currency was shown above the table of portfolio holdings in our example.
examples.zh: 在我们的示例中，「基金基础货币」写在组合持仓表的上方。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the report expressed net assets in the fund base currency.
examples.zh: 导师问，报告是否用「基金基础货币」表示净资产。

collocations: express values in the fund base currency
report in the fund base currency

words.enDefinition: the currency in which a class's values are quoted

examples.en: The report used the share class currency to show the price of one unit.
examples.zh: 报告使用「份额类别计价货币」表示一份基金单位的价格。

examples.en: We checked the share class currency before comparing two columns of unit prices in the factsheet.
examples.zh: 比较概况表中两栏单位价格前，我们核对了「份额类别计价货币」。

collocations: quote prices in the share class currency
a change in the share class currency

words.enDefinition: the jurisdiction in which a fund is legally established

examples.en: The fund domicile appeared beside the address of the fund manager on the factsheet.
examples.zh: 「基金注册地」列在概况表上基金管理人地址的旁边。

examples.en: The tutor asked why the fund domicile differed from the location of its largest holdings.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么「基金注册地」和最大几项持仓的所在地并不相同。

collocations: the fund domicile stated in the prospectus

words.enDefinition: one fund structure containing several distinct sub-funds

examples.en: The exercise described an umbrella fund containing separate portfolios for domestic and international holdings.
examples.zh: 练习介绍了一只「伞形基金」，其中本国持仓和国际持仓分属不同组合。

examples.en: We found the name of the umbrella fund above the list of available sub-funds.
examples.zh: 我们在可用子基金清单上方找到了「伞形基金」的名称。

collocations: a sub-fund within an umbrella fund

words.enDefinition: a distinct investment pool within a larger umbrella fund

examples.en: The sub-fund in the case had its own objective even though the umbrella name was shared.
examples.zh: 案例中的「子基金」虽然使用共同的伞形基金名称，但有自己的投资目标。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which sub-fund the return chart described before we compared the reported numbers.
examples.zh: 比较报告中的数据前，导师让我们确认回报图表说的是哪只「子基金」。

words.enDefinition: a fund that invests mainly in other funds

examples.en: The classroom fund of funds held three underlying funds instead of buying the securities directly.
examples.zh: 课堂样本的「基金中的基金」持有三只底层基金，没有直接买入相关证券。

examples.en: We checked the layered charges in the prospectus for the sample fund of funds.
examples.zh: 我们查了样本「基金中的基金」招募说明书里分别列出的多层费用。

collocations: fees for a fund of funds

words.enDefinition: recurring expenses paid each year from a fund's assets

examples.en: The table listed annual operating expenses separately from fees charged directly to the sample shareholder.
examples.zh: 表格把「年度运作费用」和直接向样本持有人收取的费用分开列出。

examples.en: We checked which items counted toward annual operating expenses in the fictional fund's prospectus.
examples.zh: 我们查阅了虚构基金的招募说明书，确认哪些项目计入「年度运作费用」。

collocations: annual operating expenses of a fund

words.zhGloss: 持有人直接承担的费用
words.enDefinition: fees charged directly to investors in a fund
acceptedZhAnswers: 持有人直接承担的费用

examples.en: The sample prospectus listed shareholder fees for certain transactions in a separate part of the table.
examples.zh: 样本招募说明书在表格的另一区域列出了特定交易产生的「持有人直接承担的费用」。

examples.en: Our exercise separated shareholder fees from the charges that came out of the fund's own assets.
examples.zh: 我们的练习把「持有人直接承担的费用」与从基金资产中扣除的费用分开列出。

collocations: shareholder fees paid directly by investors

words.enDefinition: annual fund operating expenses expressed as a percentage of average net assets

examples.en: The instructor asked whether the expense ratio included the charge paid directly on each purchase.
examples.zh: 老师问，「基金费用率」是否包括每次申购时直接支付的费用。

examples.en: We compared the expense ratio of two fictional funds with very different net asset sizes.
examples.zh: 我们比较了净资产规模差异很大的两只虚构基金的「基金费用率」。

words.enDefinition: the expense ratio before waivers or reimbursements are applied

examples.en: The gross expense ratio in our sample used operating costs before the adviser waived any fees.
examples.zh: 样本中的「未减免费用率」按投资顾问尚未减免费用时的运作成本计算。

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to find the gross expense ratio in the left column of the table.
examples.zh: 导师让我们在表格左栏找到「未减免费用率」。

words.enDefinition: the expense ratio after applicable waivers or reimbursements

examples.en: The net expense ratio in the example was lower because an adviser reimbursed some expenses.
examples.zh: 示例中的「减免后费用率」较低，因为投资顾问返还了部分费用。

examples.en: We checked whether the same arrangement explained both the net expense ratio and its footnote.
examples.zh: 我们核对「减免后费用率」及其脚注说的是不是同一项安排。

collocations: the net expense ratio after waivers

words.enDefinition: an agreement in which a provider gives up specified fees

examples.en: The hypothetical adviser agreed to a contractual fee waiver lasting through the dates in our case.
examples.zh: 假设中的投资顾问同意「合同约定的费用减免」，有效期涵盖案例所列日期。

examples.en: The footnote said that the contractual fee waiver applied to only one of the share classes.
examples.zh: 脚注说明，「合同约定的费用减免」只适用于其中一个份额类别。

words.enDefinition: a payment covering fund expenses already incurred

examples.en: The fictional fund recorded an expense reimbursement from its adviser in the statement of operations.
examples.zh: 这只虚构基金在经营报表上记录了投资顾问提供的一笔「费用补偿」。

examples.en: Our group checked whether the expense reimbursement changed what the sample fund ultimately paid that year.
examples.zh: 我们小组核对了「费用补偿」有没有改变样本基金该年最终支付的金额。

words.enDefinition: an agreed limit on certain expenses borne by the fund

examples.en: The expense cap in the sample applied to certain operating expenses listed in a footnote.
examples.zh: 样本说明，「基金费用上限」适用于脚注列出的某些运作费用。

examples.en: We discussed how an expense cap might affect the net ratio shown in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「基金费用上限」可能怎样影响练习表中的减免后费用率。

words.enDefinition: the last date on which a stated expense waiver applies

examples.en: The expense waiver expiration date appeared beside the lower expense ratio in our classroom document.
examples.zh: 我们的课堂文件在较低的费用率旁标出了「费用减免到期日」。

examples.en: Our group marked the expense waiver expiration date before comparing the fund's estimated costs across periods.
examples.zh: 我们小组先圈出「费用减免到期日」，再比较基金各期的估算费用。

collocations: state an expense waiver expiration date
check the expense waiver expiration date
disclose the expense waiver expiration date

words.enDefinition: fund costs indirectly incurred through investments in other funds

examples.en: The sample fee table showed acquired fund fees and expenses below the fund's own operating expenses.
examples.zh: 样本费用表在基金自身运作费用的下方列出了「所投资基金的费用」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why acquired fund fees and expenses appeared when the fund held other funds.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么当基金持有别的基金时，会出现「所投资基金的费用」。

collocations: disclose acquired fund fees and expenses
include acquired fund fees and expenses
a line for acquired fund fees and expenses

words.enDefinition: a US fund fee for distribution and sometimes shareholder services

examples.en: The sample share class paid a 12b-1 fee from fund assets for distribution and services.
examples.zh: 样本份额类别从基金资产中支付「美国基金分销服务费」，用于分销和持有人服务。

examples.en: We searched the US prospectus fee table for the line showing the annual 12b-1 fee.
examples.zh: 我们在美国招募说明书的费用表里找到了列示年度「美国基金分销服务费」的一行。

words.enDefinition: a UK fund disclosure measure of specified recurring expenses

examples.en: The archived UK document showed an ongoing charges figure alongside a separate note about transaction costs.
examples.zh: 这份存档的英国文件列有「持续费用率」，另有说明解释交易成本。

examples.en: We compared the ongoing charges figure in the archived document with the fees in our sample.
examples.zh: 我们将存档文件中的「持续费用率」与样本里的费用作了比较。

words.enDefinition: a sales charge paid when buying certain fund shares

examples.en: In the classroom example, the front-end sales load reduced the amount invested in fund shares.
examples.zh: 课堂示例中，「前端销售费」减少了实际投入基金份额的金额。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to separate the front-end sales load from ongoing expenses in the table.
examples.zh: 导师让我们在费用表中区分「前端销售费」和持续费用。

collocations: a fund with a front-end sales load

words.enDefinition: a sales charge imposed on redemption under stated holding conditions

examples.en: The hypothetical contingent deferred sales charge applied when shares were sold before the stated holding period ended.
examples.zh: 假设中的「有条件递延销售费」适用于在规定持有期结束前卖出的份额。

examples.en: We found the contingent deferred sales charge in a footnote to the sample fee table.
examples.zh: 我们在样本费用表的脚注里找到了「有条件递延销售费」。

collocations: incur a contingent deferred sales charge
waive a contingent deferred sales charge
a schedule for the contingent deferred sales charge

words.enDefinition: a fund sold without a front-end or deferred sales load, although it may have other charges and operating expenses

examples.en: The sample no-load fund still reported annual operating expenses in its table of estimated costs.
examples.zh: 样本「无销售佣金基金」仍在估算成本表中报告年度运作费用。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why the cost example for a no-load fund might still show substantial expenses.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么「无销售佣金基金」的成本示例仍可能显示有可观费用。

collocations: operating expenses of a no-load fund
classify a fund as a no-load fund

words.enDefinition: a reduced sales charge once an eligible investment amount is reached

examples.en: The case used a breakpoint discount to show why purchase size affected the stated sales charge.
examples.zh: 案例通过「达额销售费折扣」说明，为什么申购金额会影响所列销售费。

examples.en: We read the sample prospectus to find the purchase amounts associated with each breakpoint discount.
examples.zh: 我们阅读样本招募说明书，找出了每档「达额销售费折扣」对应的申购金额。

words.enDefinition: a sales-charge discount mechanism counting eligible existing holdings toward a breakpoint

examples.en: The example's rights of accumulation counted eligible existing holdings when determining the purchase's sales charge.
examples.zh: 示例中的「累积投资折扣权」把符合条件的现有持仓计入计算申购销售费的基数。

examples.en: Our class compared rights of accumulation with a commitment to make purchases over a future period.
examples.zh: 我们班把「累积投资折扣权」与承诺在未来一段时间内申购的做法作了比较。

words.enDefinition: a written purchase commitment that may qualify for a sales-load discount

examples.en: In our US fund case, a letter of intent specified purchases over a stated period.
examples.zh: 我们分析的美国基金案例中，「基金申购意向书」注明了在指定期间内的申购安排。

examples.en: The sample prospectus explained how the sales charge would change if the letter of intent was unfulfilled.
examples.zh: 样本招募说明书解释了没有履行「基金申购意向书」时，销售费会有什么变化。

collocations: meet a letter of intent commitment
purchases covered by a letter of intent

words.enDefinition: a fee paid to the fund when shares are redeemed under specified conditions

examples.en: The sample fund's redemption fee applied to shares redeemed within a specified holding period.
examples.zh: 样本基金的「赎回费」适用于在指定持有期内赎回的份额。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why the redemption fee appeared separately from the sales load in the prospectus.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么招募说明书把「赎回费」和销售费分开列示。

words.enDefinition: a charge paid to the fund on certain purchases of its shares

examples.en: The sample purchase fee went to the fund rather than to an outside distributor.
examples.zh: 样本中的「基金申购费」归基金所有，不支付给外部销售机构。

examples.en: We checked whether the purchase fee appeared in the table for both fictional share classes.
examples.zh: 我们核对「基金申购费」是否出现在两个虚构份额类别的表里。

collocations: purchase fee payable to the fund

words.enDefinition: a fee for exchanging shares between qualifying funds

examples.en: The sample's exchange fee applied to moving between two funds within the same fund family.
examples.zh: 样本中的「基金转换费」适用于同一基金家族中两只基金之间的转换。

examples.en: The tutor asked which transactions would incur an exchange fee under the fictional prospectus terms.
examples.zh: 导师问，按虚构招募说明书的条款，哪些交易会产生「基金转换费」。

words.enDefinition: a fee directly charged for maintaining a fund shareholder's account

examples.en: The sample's shareholder account fee depended on the account balance under the stated fee schedule.
examples.zh: 根据列出的收费规则，样本中的「基金账户费用」取决于账户余额。

examples.en: We found the shareholder account fee in the column for amounts charged directly to holders.
examples.zh: 我们在持有人直接支付金额的那一栏找到了「基金账户费用」。

words.enDefinition: a charge for safeguarding fund assets and related services

examples.en: The fund's custody fee covered safekeeping the securities shown in the classroom holdings schedule.
examples.zh: 基金的「托管费」用于保管课堂持仓明细表所列的证券。

examples.en: The sample expense breakdown listed a custody fee separately from the manager's advisory charge.
examples.zh: 样本费用明细将「托管费」和管理人的投资顾问费分开列出。

words.enDefinition: a fee for maintaining shareholder records and processing fund transactions

examples.en: The sample fund's transfer agent fee covered work on account records and share transactions.
examples.zh: 样本基金的「过户代理费」涵盖了账户记录和份额交易的处理工作。

examples.en: Our group added the transfer agent fee to the other costs shown in the operating table.
examples.zh: 我们小组把「过户代理费」加进运作费用表里的其他费用。

words.enDefinition: a fee for the fund's administrative and accounting services

examples.en: The classroom fund's administration agreement charged a fund administration fee for accounting and record preparation.
examples.zh: 课堂示例基金的行政服务协议列有「基金行政管理费」，用于会计和记录编制。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the fund administration fee was included in the sample's other expenses.
examples.zh: 导师问，样本的其他费用里是否包含「基金行政管理费」。

words.enDefinition: a fee linked to investment results under stated terms

examples.en: The sample performance fee depended on results measured against the benchmark defined in the document.
examples.zh: 样本「业绩报酬」取决于按文件规定的基准衡量的业绩。

examples.en: We checked how the performance fee appeared in the cost breakdown of the fictional fund.
examples.zh: 我们查了「业绩报酬」在虚构基金的成本明细里是怎么列示的。

words.enDefinition: a previous value peak that must be exceeded before new performance fees accrue

examples.en: In the example, the high-water mark prevented another fee while the fund merely recovered previous losses.
examples.zh: 示例中的基金仅弥补此前亏损时，「业绩报酬高水位线」使它不会再次产生费用。

examples.en: Our tutor marked the high-water mark on the chart before discussing the next performance fee calculation.
examples.zh: 导师在图上标出「业绩报酬高水位线」，再讨论下一次业绩报酬怎么计算。

collocations: a performance fee with a high-water mark

words.enDefinition: a minimum result required before a performance fee is payable

examples.en: The worksheet compared the sample fund's result with the performance fee hurdle stated in its terms.
examples.zh: 练习表将样本基金的业绩与条款列出的「业绩报酬门槛」作了比较。

examples.en: The tutor asked whether the performance fee hurdle was a fixed rate or a benchmark return.
examples.zh: 导师问，「业绩报酬门槛」是固定比率还是基准回报率。

words.enDefinition: costs incurred when a fund trades its investments

examples.en: The sample fund reported portfolio transaction costs separately from the ongoing charges on the factsheet.
examples.zh: 这只样本基金把「组合交易成本」和概况表里的持续费用分开报告。

examples.en: Our exercise showed how frequent trading could affect portfolio transaction costs for the hypothetical fund.
examples.zh: 练习展示了频繁交易可能怎样影响假设基金的「组合交易成本」。

words.enDefinition: adjusting a fund's dealing price to reduce dilution from investor flows

examples.en: The class discussed swing pricing after reading a case with unusually large fund redemptions.
examples.zh: 同学们读到一个基金赎回量异常大的案例后，讨论了「摆动定价」。

examples.en: Under the hypothetical swing pricing example, the dealing price reflected some trading costs from net outflows.
examples.zh: 在假设的「摆动定价」示例中，申赎价格反映了净赎回带来的部分交易成本。

collocations: disclose the use of swing pricing

words.enDefinition: a separate charge intended to offset costs caused by fund dealing

examples.en: The sample UK prospectus showed a dilution levy separately from the price of each unit.
examples.zh: 英国样本招募说明书将「反摊薄收费」与每份基金单位价格分开列示。

examples.en: We compared the dilution levy in the worksheet with an adjustment to the dealing price.
examples.zh: 我们把练习表中的「反摊薄收费」和申赎价格调整作了比较。

words.enDefinition: the value of a fund's assets minus its liabilities

examples.en: We calculated the fund's net asset value after subtracting its liabilities in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 课堂练习中，我们从基金资产中扣掉负债，算出了「基金资产净值」。

examples.en: The sample report listed net asset value before showing the number of shares in issue.
examples.zh: 样本报告先列出「基金资产净值」，再列出已发行份额数量。

collocations: a fund's total net asset value

words.enDefinition: net assets attributable to a class divided by its outstanding shares

examples.en: The exercise divided the class's net assets by its outstanding shares to find NAV per share.
examples.zh: 这道练习用该类别的净资产除以其流通在外的份额数量，求出「基金份额净值」。

examples.en: We compared the ETF's quoted market price with its NAV per share on the same date.
examples.zh: 我们把这只 ETF 的市场报价与同日的「基金份额净值」作了比较。

words.enDefinition: the time at which a fund's investments are valued for dealing

examples.en: The sample UK prospectus stated the valuation point for calculating each day's unit prices.
examples.zh: 英国样本招募说明书写明了计算每日单位价格所用的「基金估值时点」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the order preceded the valuation point shown in the exercise.
examples.zh: 导师问，订单是在练习所列的「基金估值时点」之前还是之后提交的。

words.enDefinition: a day on which a fund accepts orders for its units

examples.en: The tutor asked whether the holiday shown in the exercise counted as a dealing day.
examples.zh: 导师问，练习中列出的节假日是否算「基金申赎开放日」。

examples.en: The sample prospectus gave two examples of orders received on a dealing day that month.
examples.zh: 样本招募说明书列举了当月「基金申赎开放日」收到订单的两个例子。

words.enDefinition: the deadline for an order to use a specified valuation

examples.en: The sample's dealing cut-off appeared beside the valuation time for orders received that day.
examples.zh: 样本把「基金申赎截止时间」列在当日所收订单的估值时间旁。

examples.en: We checked the dealing cut-off before assigning a valuation date to the hypothetical order.
examples.zh: 我们先核对了「基金申赎截止时间」，再为这个假设订单确定估值日期。

words.enDefinition: pricing an accepted order using the next calculated fund value

examples.en: The tutor explained forward pricing using an order submitted before the next net asset value calculation.
examples.zh: 导师用一笔在下次计算基金资产净值前提交的订单解释了「按下一次估值定价」。

examples.en: Under forward pricing, the sample investor did not know the final price when submitting the order.
examples.zh: 采用「按下一次估值定价」时，样本中的投资人在提交订单时并不知道最终成交价。

words.enDefinition: the price at which a fund issues or redeems units

examples.en: The dealing price in our example reflected a stated adjustment for unusual net outflows.
examples.zh: 我们示例中的「基金申赎价格」反映了因异常资金净流出而作出的调整。

examples.en: We distinguished the dealing price from the amount that the investor would receive after charges.
examples.zh: 我们区分了「基金申赎价格」和扣除费用后投资人实际会收到的金额。

collocations: an adjustment to the dealing price

words.expression: trade at a premium to NAV
words.lemma: trade at a premium to nav
words.zhGloss: 以高于净值的价格交易
words.enDefinition: to trade above a fund's net asset value per share
acceptedZhAnswers: 以高于净值的价格交易
acceptedEnVariants: trade at a premium to NAV

examples.en: Our tutor showed how ETF shares can trade at a premium to NAV on the exchange.
examples.zh: 导师演示了 ETF 份额如何在交易所「以高于净值的价格交易」。

examples.en: The worksheet assumed shares would trade at a premium to NAV on the first sample day.
examples.zh: 练习表假定份额在样本的第一天「以高于净值的价格交易」。

collocations: trade at a premium to NAV at the close
continue to trade at a premium to NAV
briefly trade at a premium to NAV

words.expression: trade at a discount to NAV
words.lemma: trade at a discount to nav
words.zhGloss: 以低于净值的价格交易
words.enDefinition: to trade below a fund's net asset value per share
acceptedZhAnswers: 以低于净值的价格交易
acceptedEnVariants: trade at a discount to NAV

examples.en: The lecturer used the sample prices to show what it means to trade at a discount to NAV.
examples.zh: 讲师用样本价格说明「以低于净值的价格交易」是什么意思。

examples.en: Our first calculation showed that the ETF could trade at a discount to NAV that afternoon.
examples.zh: 我们的第一项计算显示，这只 ETF 那天下午可能「以低于净值的价格交易」。

collocations: continue to trade at a discount to NAV
trade at a discount to NAV at the close
occasionally trade at a discount to NAV

words.enDefinition: an estimated per-share value updated during the trading day

examples.en: The sample chart showed the intraday indicative value at several times before the market closed.
examples.zh: 样本图表列出了收盘前不同时点的「盘中参考净值」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why the intraday indicative value differed from the final NAV per share.
examples.zh: 导师问，「盘中参考净值」为什么与最终公布的基金份额净值不同。

collocations: compare price with the intraday indicative value

words.zhGloss: 三十日买卖价差中位数
words.enDefinition: the median relative bid-ask spread over the previous thirty days
acceptedZhAnswers: 三十日买卖价差中位数

examples.en: The sample ETF page showed the median 30-day bid-ask spread as a percentage of the quoted midpoint.
examples.zh: 样本 ETF 页面以买卖报价中点的百分比表示「三十日买卖价差中位数」。

examples.en: We located the median 30-day bid-ask spread beside the fund's market price and NAV per share.
examples.zh: 我们在基金市价与份额净值旁找到了「三十日买卖价差中位数」。

words.enDefinition: a large block of shares created or redeemed directly with an ETF

examples.en: The sample ETF prospectus defined a creation unit as a block of fifty thousand shares.
examples.zh: 样本 ETF 招募说明书将一个「ETF申购单位」定义为五万份基金份额。

examples.en: The tutor asked why one creation unit was much larger than a typical exchange order.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么一个「ETF申购单位」远大于普通的交易所订单。

collocations: the size of a creation unit

words.enDefinition: the assets or cash delivered to create ETF shares

examples.en: The sample's creation basket included several securities and a small amount of cash.
examples.zh: 样本中的「ETF申购组合」包括几种证券和少量现金。

examples.en: Our exercise compared the creation basket with the ETF's complete holdings on the same date.
examples.zh: 练习把「ETF申购组合」和该 ETF 同日的全部持仓作了比较。

words.enDefinition: the assets or cash delivered when ETF shares are redeemed

examples.en: The sample report described the securities included in the redemption basket for that afternoon.
examples.zh: 样本报告介绍了当天下午「ETF赎回组合」中包含的证券。

examples.en: The class compared the redemption basket with the creation basket shown in the exercise.
examples.zh: 同学们把「ETF赎回组合」与练习中列出的申购组合做了比较。

words.enDefinition: an eligible institution with an agreement allowing it to create or redeem large blocks of ETF shares directly with the fund

examples.en: The authorized participant in our case exchanged a basket of securities for one block of ETF shares.
examples.zh: 案例中的「ETF 授权参与机构」以一篮子证券换取一整批 ETF 份额。

examples.en: We checked which role the authorized participant played in the exercise's diagram of ETF trading.
examples.zh: 我们核对了「ETF 授权参与机构」在练习所附 ETF 交易流程图中所起的作用。

collocations: an agreement with an authorized participant

words.enDefinition: redeeming shares using assets other than cash

examples.en: The exercise described an in-kind redemption that transferred securities instead of paying the full amount in cash.
examples.zh: 练习描述了一笔通过交付证券完成的「实物赎回」，没有全额以现金支付。

examples.en: Our tutor used the basket in the sample filing to illustrate how an in-kind redemption worked.
examples.zh: 导师用样本申报文件中的一篮子资产说明「实物赎回」是怎么回事。

collocations: securities delivered in an in-kind redemption

words.enDefinition: cash distributions expressed as a percentage of a reference price or value

examples.en: The sample fund page showed distribution yield beside the period used for its payment figures.
examples.zh: 样本基金页面在分配所采用的期间旁列出了「分配收益率」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why the distribution yield differed when the two fact sheets used different reference prices.
examples.zh: 导师问，两份概况表用的参考价格不同，为什么「分配收益率」也不同。

collocations: the basis for a distribution yield

words.zhGloss: 美国 SEC 三十日收益率
words.enDefinition: an annualised measure of net investment income over a 30-day period, calculated using a standard US SEC formula
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国 SEC 三十日收益率

examples.en: The sample bond fund offered a 30-day SEC yield alongside figures for its actual distributions.
examples.zh: 样本债券基金在实际分配数据旁列出了「美国 SEC 三十日收益率」。

examples.en: The tutor asked why the 30-day SEC yield could differ from the fund's recent payments.
examples.zh: 导师问，「美国 SEC 三十日收益率」为什么可能与基金近期的分配金额不同。

words.enDefinition: the amount a fund distributes for each eligible share

examples.en: The sample's distribution per share appeared beside the date it would be paid to holders.
examples.zh: 样本把「每份基金份额分配额」列在向持有人付款日期的旁边。

examples.en: We multiplied the distribution per share by the number of units in the classroom account.
examples.zh: 我们用「每份基金份额分配额」乘以课堂示例账户中的份额数量。

words.enDefinition: a payment of realised investment gains to fund shareholders

examples.en: The annual report identified a capital gains distribution after the hypothetical fund sold several investments.
examples.zh: 年度报告显示，假设基金在出售几项投资后进行了「资本利得分配」。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why a capital gains distribution could appear even when the fund's price fell.
examples.zh: 导师解释，为什么基金价格下跌时也可能出现「资本利得分配」。

words.enDefinition: to use fund payouts to buy additional shares

examples.en: The example assumed shareholders would reinvest distributions when it estimated changes in the account's value.
examples.zh: 示例在估算账户价值的变化时，假设持有人会「将分配所得再投资」。

examples.en: The sample prospectus described how the fictional shareholder could reinvest distributions in the same fund.
examples.zh: 样本招募说明书说明了虚构的持有人怎样在同一基金中「将分配所得再投资」。

words.enDefinition: a listing of a fund's past payouts and related dates

examples.en: The distribution history gave the amount paid at the end of each quarter that year.
examples.zh: 「历次分配记录」列出了该年每季期末所分配的金额。

examples.en: We checked whether the fund's distribution history included income and capital gains in separate columns.
examples.zh: 我们查看「历次分配记录」是否用不同栏列示收益和资本利得。

words.enDefinition: the investment return earned within one calendar year

examples.en: The bar chart showed a separate calendar-year return for every full year in the example.
examples.zh: 柱状图对示例中的每个完整年份分别给出「按自然年列示的回报率」。

examples.en: The tutor asked how the latest calendar-year return differed from the figure reported since inception.
examples.zh: 导师问，最近的「自然年回报率」与自设立以来所报告的数字有什么差别。

words.enDefinition: the overall percentage change in value across a period

examples.en: We calculated cumulative return across three years by combining the annual growth factors in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们把练习中的年度增长因子连乘，计算三年「累计回报率」。

examples.en: The full-period cumulative return was shown beside the average yearly figure in the classroom table.
examples.zh: 课堂表格把全期「累计回报率」列在年平均数据旁边。

words.enDefinition: the constant compounded yearly rate equivalent to total return over a period

examples.en: The sample table reported average annual total return over one, five, and ten years.
examples.zh: 样本表报告了一年、五年和十年的「年化总回报率」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why the average annual total return differed from the sum of yearly figures.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么「年化总回报率」与逐年数据的总和不同。

collocations: a fund's average annual total return

words.enDefinition: the percentage change in investment value including income, typically with fund distributions treated as reinvested

examples.en: The exercise used price changes and reinvested distributions to calculate the sample fund's total return.
examples.zh: 练习用价格变动和分配再投资计算样本基金的「总回报率」。

examples.en: Our tutor used total return to compare two hypothetical funds with different distribution policies.
examples.zh: 导师用「总回报率」比较两只分配政策不同的假设基金。

words.enDefinition: fund performance calculated using net asset values and applicable distributions

examples.en: The sample ETF reported NAV return and market price return in separate columns on its factsheet.
examples.zh: 样本 ETF 在概况表中把「按净值计算的回报率」和按市价计算的回报率分开列出。

examples.en: We used the NAV return in the exercise to compare the fund's performance with its benchmark.
examples.zh: 我们用练习中的「按净值计算的回报率」将基金业绩与基准比较。

words.enDefinition: fund performance based on market prices and applicable distributions

examples.en: The market price return in the ETF example was based on stated closing prices.
examples.zh: ETF 示例中的「按市价计算的回报率」是按列出的收盘价计算的。

examples.en: The tutor asked why market price return and NAV return might differ over the same period.
examples.zh: 导师问，同一个期间内「按市价计算的回报率」和按净值计算的回报率为什么可能不同。

collocations: a comparison of market price returns

words.zhGloss: 扣除分配税后的回报率
words.enDefinition: a US fund return reflecting assumed taxes on distributions
acceptedZhAnswers: 扣除分配税后的回报率

examples.en: The table showed return after taxes on distributions and excluded taxes arising from a share sale.
examples.zh: 表里的「扣除分配税后的回报率」没有扣除卖出份额产生的税。

examples.en: We read the footnote to understand the assumptions behind return after taxes on distributions.
examples.zh: 我们读了脚注，了解「扣除分配税后的回报率」是基于什么假设计算的。

collocations: report return after taxes on distributions
assumptions for return after taxes on distributions
compare returns after taxes on distributions

words.expression: return after taxes on distributions and sale
words.lemma: return after taxes on distributions and sale
words.zhGloss: 扣除分配及卖出税后的回报率
words.enDefinition: a US fund return reflecting assumed taxes on payouts and sale
acceptedZhAnswers: 扣除分配及卖出税后的回报率
acceptedEnVariants: return after taxes on distributions and sale
return after taxes on distributions and sale of fund shares

examples.en: Our class found return after taxes on distributions and sale in the third row.
examples.zh: 全班在第三行找到了「扣除分配及卖出税后的回报率」。

examples.en: The tutor asked which assumptions were used for return after taxes on distributions and sale.
examples.zh: 导师问，「扣除分配及卖出税后的回报率」采用了哪些假设。

collocations: report return after taxes on distributions and sale
compare returns after taxes on distributions and sale
assumptions for return after taxes on distributions and sale

words.enDefinition: performance measured from the start of a fund or class

examples.en: The since-inception return in our example covered only the newer share class's first two years.
examples.zh: 我们示例中的「自设立以来回报率」仅涵盖较新的份额类别开始运作后的前两年。

examples.en: The tutor asked whether the fund's since-inception return was reported as annualised or cumulative.
examples.zh: 导师问，基金的「自设立以来回报率」用的是年化口径还是累计口径。

words.enDefinition: a return over a fixed-length window that moves through time

examples.en: We calculated a rolling return for each twelve-month window in the sample performance data.
examples.zh: 我们按样本业绩数据中的每一个十二个月窗口计算「滚动回报率」。

examples.en: The chart's rolling return series showed how results varied depending on when the period began.
examples.zh: 图里的「滚动回报率」序列表明，起始时间不同，结果也会变化。

words.enDefinition: a return based only on price movements

examples.en: The price return in the exercise excluded the distributions shown in the next column.
examples.zh: 练习中的「价格回报率」不包括下一栏里的分配收益。

examples.en: Our tutor used price return to explain why a price index could differ from its total return version.
examples.zh: 导师通过「价格回报率」解释，价格指数为何可能与对应的总回报指数不同。

collocations: compare price return with total return

words.enDefinition: the main comparison standard stated for a portfolio

examples.en: The sample equity fund listed a broad domestic index as its primary benchmark for performance.
examples.zh: 这只样本股票基金将一个覆盖面广的本国指数列为「主要业绩基准」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the primary benchmark had changed between the two versions of the report.
examples.zh: 导师问，这两版报告之间「主要业绩基准」是否有变化。

words.enDefinition: an additional comparison standard alongside a primary benchmark

examples.en: The report showed a sector index as a secondary benchmark beside the broad market index.
examples.zh: 报告把一个行业指数列为「次要业绩基准」，与宽基市场指数并列。

examples.en: The tutor asked why the fictional fund included a secondary benchmark for its smaller holdings.
examples.zh: 导师问，虚构基金为什么为其规模较小的持仓列入一个「次要业绩基准」。

words.enDefinition: an index designed to represent a broad securities market

examples.en: The US sample showed a broad-based securities market index beside the fund's average annual returns.
examples.zh: 美国样本在基金年化回报率旁列出一项「宽基证券市场指数」。

examples.en: Students compared the narrow sector index with the broad-based securities market index in the exercise.
examples.zh: 学生把练习中的窄行业指数与「宽基证券市场指数」作了比较。

collocations: compare returns with a broad-based securities market index
use a broad-based securities market index
report a broad-based securities market index

words.enDefinition: a comparison standard combining weighted returns from several components

examples.en: Our composite benchmark combined two index returns in the proportions specified on the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们的「复合业绩基准」按课堂练习表指定的比例组合了两项指数回报率。

examples.en: The factsheet explained how the composite benchmark changed when one component's weight was adjusted.
examples.zh: 概况表解释，一个成分权重调整后，「复合业绩基准」会发生什么变化。

collocations: compare performance with a composite benchmark

words.enDefinition: a comparison with funds sharing similar objectives or characteristics

examples.en: The peer group comparison in our exercise included only funds with a similar investment objective.
examples.zh: 练习中的「同类基金比较」只纳入投资目标相似的基金。

examples.en: Our tutor discussed a peer group comparison that used funds with two different reporting periods.
examples.zh: 导师讨论了一项「同类基金比较」，其中的基金使用了两个不同的报告期间。

words.enDefinition: the investments with the largest weights in a portfolio

examples.en: The fund fact sheet showed the top holdings from the last day of the quarter.
examples.zh: 基金概况表列出了截至季度最后一天的「主要持仓」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how many of the top holdings appeared in both sample reports.
examples.zh: 导师问，有多少项「主要持仓」同时出现在两份样本报告中。

words.enDefinition: the distribution of a portfolio's assets across industries

examples.en: The report's sector allocation chart showed that the sample fund held investments across several industries.
examples.zh: 报告的「行业配置」图表显示，样本基金在若干行业持有投资。

examples.en: We compared the reported sector allocation with the weights of the fund's benchmark in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们将报告的「行业配置」与练习表所列的基金基准权重作了比较。

words.enDefinition: the distribution of portfolio assets by country

examples.en: The country allocation in the factsheet used the issuer locations described in its footnote.
examples.zh: 概况表中「按国家划分的配置」使用脚注所述的发行人所在地口径。

examples.en: The exercise asked why country allocation figures might differ across two reports for the same fund.
examples.zh: 练习问，同一只基金的两份报告，「按国家划分的配置」数据为什么可能不同。

words.enDefinition: the proportion of a portfolio represented by an investment or category

examples.en: The worksheet calculated the portfolio weight of each holding using its share of total portfolio value.
examples.zh: 练习表按各项持仓占组合总值的比例计算其「投资组合权重」。

examples.en: Our class compared the portfolio weight of a holding before and after a price change.
examples.zh: 我们班比较了一项持仓在价格变动前后的「投资组合权重」。

words.enDefinition: the proportion of a benchmark assigned to an investment or category

examples.en: The benchmark weight of the sector was lower than its share of the sample portfolio.
examples.zh: 该行业的「基准权重」低于它在样本投资组合中所占的比例。

examples.en: We checked each benchmark weight before calculating the differences shown in the comparison table.
examples.zh: 我们先核对每项「基准权重」，再计算比较表中的差值。

words.enDefinition: the portfolio weight minus the corresponding benchmark weight

examples.en: The active weight was positive because the portfolio held more of the sector than the benchmark.
examples.zh: 「主动权重」为正，是因为投资组合在该行业的权重高于基准。

examples.en: Our group calculated active weight for each sector before interpreting the hypothetical fund's allocations.
examples.zh: 我们小组先计算各行业的「主动权重」，再解读假设基金的配置。

words.enDefinition: an investment position larger than the relevant comparison weight

examples.en: The report showed an overweight position in a sector that made up less of the benchmark.
examples.zh: 报告显示一个「超配头寸」，该行业在基准中占比较小。

examples.en: Our class identified an overweight position by comparing the portfolio's sector weight with the benchmark's.
examples.zh: 我们比较投资组合和基准的行业权重，找出一个「超配头寸」。

collocations: an overweight position relative to the benchmark

words.enDefinition: an investment position smaller than the relevant comparison weight

examples.en: Our worksheet showed an underweight position when the fund's sector weight was below the benchmark weight.
examples.zh: 当基金行业权重低于基准权重时，练习表显示一个「低配头寸」。

examples.en: The commentary explained why the sample portfolio maintained an underweight position in the sector that quarter.
examples.zh: 评述解释了为什么样本组合在该季度一直对该行业持有「低配头寸」。

collocations: an underweight position relative to the benchmark

words.enDefinition: lower performance caused by holding cash while other investments rise more

examples.en: The commentary attributed some of the shortfall to cash drag during the market's sharp rise.
examples.zh: 评述把市场急剧上涨时的一部分业绩缺口归因于「现金拖累」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why cash drag was visible when the sample portfolio's investments outperformed cash.
examples.zh: 导师问，样本组合的投资表现好过现金时，为什么会看出「现金拖累」。

words.enDefinition: exposure measured through the underlying assets of an indirect holding

examples.en: The analysis used look-through exposure to show which sectors were held through the underlying funds.
examples.zh: 分析用「穿透后敞口」说明通过底层基金持有哪些行业。

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to compare direct holdings with look-through exposure in the sample portfolio.
examples.zh: 导师要求我们比较样本投资组合的直接持仓和「穿透后敞口」。

words.enDefinition: a ratio estimating the extent to which a fund trades holdings

examples.en: The shareholder report listed the portfolio turnover rate for the sample fund's latest fiscal year.
examples.zh: 持有人报告列出了样本基金最近一个财年的「投资组合换手率」。

examples.en: We discussed why a higher portfolio turnover rate might be associated with more transaction costs.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么较高的「投资组合换手率」可能伴随更多交易成本。

words.enDefinition: tracking an index by holding all constituents in corresponding weights

examples.en: The fictional index tracker used full replication for a small index with twenty constituent securities.
examples.zh: 虚构的指数跟踪基金对于一个只有二十项成分证券的小指数采用「完全复制法」。

examples.en: The tutor asked how full replication would change after the index added another company.
examples.zh: 导师问，指数加入另一家公司后，采用「完全复制法」的持仓会怎样变化。

collocations: track an index through full replication

words.enDefinition: tracking an index with a subset reflecting its key characteristics

examples.en: The fund used representative sampling because the benchmark contained many securities that traded infrequently.
examples.zh: 该基金采用「代表性抽样法」，因为基准中有很多不常交易的证券。

examples.en: In class, we checked which index characteristics the representative sampling method was meant to match.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们核对了「代表性抽样法」旨在匹配指数的哪些特征。

collocations: track an index through representative sampling

words.enDefinition: the difference between fund and tracked index returns for a period

examples.en: We measured tracking difference by subtracting the index return from the sample fund's return for that year.
examples.zh: 我们用样本基金该年的回报率减去指数回报率，衡量「跟踪差异」。

examples.en: The report showed a larger tracking difference for the second fund over the same quarter.
examples.zh: 报告显示，在同一季度，第二只基金的「跟踪差异」更大。

words.enDefinition: the standard deviation of differences between portfolio and benchmark returns

examples.en: The exercise calculated tracking error from monthly differences between portfolio and benchmark returns across three years.
examples.zh: 练习根据三年间投资组合与基准的月度回报率差值计算「跟踪误差」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why low tracking error could coexist with a consistent performance gap.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么「跟踪误差」较低，业绩差距却能一直存在。

collocations: a portfolio with low tracking error

words.enDefinition: analysis explaining how investment decisions contributed to portfolio results

examples.en: The performance attribution table separated the effects of sector weights from choices within each sector.
examples.zh: 「业绩归因」表区分了行业权重和行业内投资选择带来的影响。

examples.en: Our tutor used performance attribution to discuss why the sample fund lagged behind its benchmark.
examples.zh: 导师用「业绩归因」讨论为什么样本基金业绩落后于基准。

words.enDefinition: the amount of a portfolio's overall return attributable to a component

examples.en: The report showed each holding's contribution to return in percentage points for the quarter.
examples.zh: 报告以百分点列示了该季度各项持仓的「回报贡献」。

examples.en: We checked why one sizeable holding made a negative contribution to return in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们核对了练习中的一项大额持仓为什么带来了负的「回报贡献」。

words.enDefinition: the effect on relative performance of weighting sectors differently from a benchmark

examples.en: The worksheet showed a positive sector allocation effect after the sample fund overweighted a strong sector.
examples.zh: 样本基金超配了表现强劲的行业后，练习表显示「行业配置效应」为正。

examples.en: Our tutor asked what the sector allocation effect said about the portfolio's sector weights.
examples.zh: 导师问，从「行业配置效应」能看出投资组合行业权重安排的哪些信息。

words.enDefinition: the effect of security choices within a group on relative performance

examples.en: The security selection effect was negative when the chosen companies lagged behind their industry comparison.
examples.zh: 所选公司表现落后于行业参照时，「证券选择效应」为负。

examples.en: Our tutor used the security selection effect to discuss what happened within the sample's largest sector.
examples.zh: 导师用「证券选择效应」讨论样本中占比最大的行业内部发生了什么。

words.enDefinition: average active return divided by tracking error

examples.en: We calculated the information ratio from the sample's active return and its tracking error.
examples.zh: 我们用样本的主动回报和跟踪误差计算「信息比率」。

examples.en: The tutor asked why the information ratio changed when we used a different benchmark.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么换了基准后，「信息比率」也跟着变了。

words.enDefinition: excess return over a risk-free rate divided by return volatility

examples.en: The exercise calculated the Sharpe ratio using the same risk-free rate for both hypothetical portfolios.
examples.zh: 练习用同一个无风险利率计算两只假设投资组合的「夏普比率」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why a higher return did not necessarily produce a higher Sharpe ratio.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么较高的回报率未必会带来较高的「夏普比率」。

words.enDefinition: the largest percentage drop from a peak to a subsequent trough

examples.en: The chart showed a maximum drawdown during the steepest fall in the sample portfolio's value.
examples.zh: 图表显示，样本投资组合价值跌得最厉害时出现了「最大回撤」。

examples.en: We checked whether changing the observation period altered the calculated maximum drawdown in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们核对了改变观察期会不会改变练习中算出的「最大回撤」。

words.enDefinition: portfolio return relative to benchmark return during positive benchmark periods

examples.en: We used only quarters when the benchmark rose to calculate the sample's upside capture ratio.
examples.zh: 我们只用基准上涨的季度来计算样本的「上涨捕获率」。

examples.en: The tutor asked why the upside capture ratio and the overall relative return could differ.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么「上涨捕获率」和总体相对回报率可能不一样。

words.enDefinition: portfolio return relative to benchmark return during negative benchmark periods

examples.en: The example calculated downside capture ratio using only months when the benchmark return was negative.
examples.zh: 示例只使用基准回报率为负的月份计算「下跌捕获率」。

examples.en: We examined the downside capture ratio after marking the periods when the benchmark fell.
examples.zh: 我们先标出基准下跌的时期，再查看「下跌捕获率」。

words.enDefinition: a change in portfolio weights away from their targets

examples.en: Price changes caused portfolio drift even though the sample fund had made no new trades.
examples.zh: 尽管样本基金没有新交易，价格变动仍造成了「组合权重偏离」。

examples.en: Our class checked how much portfolio drift had occurred since the allocation targets were last set.
examples.zh: 我们班核对了自上次设定配置目标以来出现了多大的「组合权重偏离」。

words.enDefinition: a specified deviation that triggers an adjustment toward target weights

examples.en: The course example set a rebalancing threshold based on each asset group's deviation from its target.
examples.zh: 课程示例按照各类资产偏离自身目标的程度设定「再平衡触发阈值」。

examples.en: Our lecturer asked which holding had crossed the rebalancing threshold in the sample worksheet.
examples.zh: 讲师问，样本练习表中哪项持仓已超过「再平衡触发阈值」。

words.enDefinition: the extent to which portfolios hold the same investments

examples.en: The exercise checked portfolio overlap between two sample funds with very different names and objectives.
examples.zh: 练习检查了两个名称和目标相差很大的样本基金的「组合持仓重叠」情况。

examples.en: Our tutor used portfolio overlap to explain why comparing fund names alone gave an incomplete picture.
examples.zh: 导师用「组合持仓重叠」说明为什么仅比较基金名称会遗漏一些情况。

words.enDefinition: the extent to which portfolio weights differ from benchmark weights

examples.en: Our example showed higher active share when several holding weights differed sharply from the benchmark.
examples.zh: 我们的示例中，有几项持仓权重明显不同于基准时，「主动份额」较高。

examples.en: The tutor asked why active share and tracking error could give different impressions of the same portfolio.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么「主动份额」和跟踪误差对同一投资组合给出的印象可能不一样。

collocations: a portfolio with high active share
